ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms toy scope, an expiry and the production-use flag are declared; it does not enforce the expiry.
offer: Limit any relaxed secret policy to disposable local experiments with an expiry. A toy exception must never extend to production or shared customer systems.

minimal.reason: Limit the relaxation to a named disposable scope, such as a local experiment. An open-ended exception becomes permanent, so state the scope.

mid.reason: Set an expiry in days, at least 1. A relaxation without an end date lingers, so state when it lapses.

maximal.reason: Set permitting production use to false. A toy exception must never reach production or shared customer systems, so keep it local.
